Medical Food 
Supplements
Use a variety of high-calorie, high-protein
supplements to increase overall nutritional intake.
These can include modular supplements added to
foods or liquid supplements as an addition to the
regular diet.
Vitamin/Mineral
Supplements
Assess ability to meet nutritional needs from a 
variety of foods and then make recommendations 
for additional micronutrient supplementation.
Speciﬁ c attention should be given to calcium,
vitamin D, and sources of antioxidants.
